sources.title: 2024年欣巴巴事業股份有限公司永續報告書
sources.locator: PDF pp. 3–4 (reporting scope and period); p. 58, section 3.3 永續供應鏈管理
sources.note: States the report covers 2024. Supplier section describes a supplier-evaluation process and says the company will not rely on only one supplier for raw materials; it does not name 中鋼 or rank rebar suppliers.

sources.title: 欣巴巴事業股份有限公司：供應商管理政策及執行情形
sources.locator: PDF p. 1, section 一、供應商評估, subsection (一) 鋼筋材料供應商
sources.note: Names 沛波鋼鐵股份有限公司 and 羅東鋼鐵廠股份有限公司 as rebar-material suppliers. The disclosure gives no procurement shares or ranking and does not say the list is exhaustive.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused issuer-source research found no disclosure identifying 中鋼 as a main rebar supplier or giving supplier-level rebar purchasing amounts or rankings. The remaining scope and denominator are unresolved.
The claim provides no date or definition of “主要供應商” (for example, by purchase value, volume, or approved-vendor status).
The issuer sources reviewed do not provide supplier-specific rebar procurement data sufficient to determine whether 中鋼 was a main supplier.
The named-supplier list is evidence of other identified suppliers, not conclusive evidence that 中鋼 was not also a supplier.
